unintendedEffects.what: Phase 9.7 leaves 11,999,712,006,910 wei of minter principal on YieldStrategyDolaLegacy on the broadcast chain, contradicting its own require(principalOf == 0), which passed only in simulation. Cause: MockAutoDOLA's time-based yield makes convertToAssets credit more principal at the on-chain mint (block 434) than in the single-timestamp simulation, and withdrawAsOwner's amount (5000e18) is baked from simulation. Consequence: the minter is the sole principal holder on a strategy SYA no longer lists, so legacy totalBalanceOf(minter) = 3,299.64 DOLA accrues to a bucket nobody skims.

simulate-yield.sh mints 2,300 DOLA into MockAutoDOLA; it reaches only the de-registered legacy strategy (SYA lists sDOLA + USDC; legacy withdrawer revoked). The live DOLA path (minter, V2, SYA on sDOLA) gets zero simulated yield.
